questions.subject: MATH
questions.learningObjective: Solve problems involving finite automata and formal languages.
questions.stem: Under the stated conditions, how many states does a deterministic finite automaton need to recognize binary sequences whose last 5 bits form a fixed pattern?

options.misconception: Wrong belief "allocates one state per pattern bit" gives 5, not 32.
Wrong belief "uses half the required states" gives 16, not 32.
Wrong belief "doubles instead of exponentiating" gives 10, not 32.

questions.explanation: A DFA must remember the entire last 5 bits, of which there are 2 to the power 5 possibilities, so it needs 32 states.
questions.hint: Remember every possible suffix of length k.
